parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program

ns2:course.label: Communications Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised experience in a field directly pertaining to agricultural leadership, education, or communications. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated up to 12 hours, if topics vary. Credit is not given for more than a total of 12 hours of Independent Study (IND) courses applying to a degree in ACES. Prerequisite: ALEC Program approval required.
